core_claims.name: Tm / rename / subst / beta
core_claims.scope: Intrinsically scoped untyped de Bruijn syntax for every natural scope, including open terms. Simultaneous substitution lifts replacement terms under binders to prevent capture. No object-language type or termination restriction.

core_claims.name: Step / Steps / stepsTrans / stepsLam / stepsLeft / stepsRight
core_claims.scope: Full unrestricted beta contraction with reduction under lambdas and on both application sides; finite reflexive-transitive paths, their concatenation and contextual lifting.

core_claims.name: FullNeutral / FullNormal / progress
core_claims.scope: Structural full normal forms and a constructive normal-form-or-next-step result for every well-scoped term, including arbitrary open terms. The selected next step follows normal order.

core_claims.name: fullNormalNoStep / fullNeutralNoStep / noStepIsNormal
core_claims.scope: Structural full normality is equivalent to absence of any full beta step, with no closedness assumption.

core_claims.name: normalize / NormalizeResult
core_claims.scope: Total fuel-bounded full normal-order evaluator. Every outcome contains a Steps trace. Exhaustion proves trace length equals fuel; successful normalization proves trace length is strictly less than fuel and carries a FullNormal endpoint certificate. No conclusion of divergence follows from exhaustion.

core_claims.name: church / churchAdd / churchNormal / churchTwoPlusTwo / churchTwoPlusTwoFinishes
core_claims.scope: Church numerals at every natural number, proof all are full normal forms, addition encoding, and checked normalization of two plus two to Church four with successful completion.

core_claims.name: scott / scottCase / fixpoint / scottAdd / scottMultiply
core_claims.scope: Scott natural-number/case and genuine untyped self-application fixpoint encodings; recursive Scott addition and multiplication. The encodings are finite syntax, not total object-level evaluators.

core_claims.name: scottTwoPlusTwo / scottTwoTimesTwo / scottArithmeticFinishes
core_claims.scope: Both Scott arithmetic expressions normalize to the same term as Scott four, and separate checked completion flags rule out merely comparing exhausted residuals.

core_claims.name: captureAvoidance / underBinder / omegaLoops
core_claims.scope: Checked capture avoidance, full reduction beneath a lambda, and a beta self-loop for Omega. The self-loop is not by itself used as a proof that every strategy diverges.

deviations: Scopes use Nat and Fin instead of repeated singleton-type contexts; unrestricted untyped terms and full beta reduction are retained.
Structural full normal-form predicates are named FullNeutral/FullNormal to distinguish them from weak head predicates. The full normalizer remains here; the separate weak evaluator is in BigStep.

Church numerals use a total syntax-generating function at arbitrary Nat. Scott arithmetic and fixpoint examples are retained, including a checked multiplication solution. Exercise numbering and presentation are adapted.
General normal-order standardisation is explained but not formalized, matching the upstream chapter: no theorem claiming termination of every normalizable term under normalize is exported.
